name: hindsight
description: Look back at how you work with AI coding agents. Local insights and actionable tips from your Claude Code and Codex history.

interface.longDescription: Reads your local Claude Code and Codex history, finds what slows you down and what it costs, and writes a private HTML report with tips. The analysis runs in your own agent; nothing is uploaded.
defaultPrompt: Run hindsight on my agent history.
What slows me down when I work with agents?
Turn my hindsight findings into CLAUDE.md edits.
